title: Pope v Curl: entry from the Court’s Book of Orders
lineage: Inspected indicated passages; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.locator: Transcription of 5 June order, The National Archives C 33 376/350
passages.note: On Friday 5 June 1741 the court ordered a temporary injunction restraining Curll and agents from printing, publishing and vending the specified Pope letters pending an answer and further order. The order reproduces allegations, not proof of final judgment or payment.
